data_description.absent_minutes: The device must have been out of range at least this long for its return to start a sync.
data_description.record_interval: Not documented by Atmotube; 60 s is the community-observed value. It is checked automatically against consecutive history batches.
data_description.confirm_interval: Tick only after verifying the interval yourself, e.g. when the automatic check was fooled by a recording gap. Batches held for the check are then imported.

error.influx_failed: Could not reach InfluxDB or the bucket was not found.

state.awaiting_interval_check: Holding data until interval is confirmed

interval_mismatch.title: Atmotube history record interval mismatch
interval_mismatch.description:
History sync for {name} stopped: consecutive history batches imply {measured} s between records, but {configured} s is configured. Nothing was acknowledged, so the device keeps the data.

If the measured value is right, change "Seconds between history records" in the integration options. If the device was switched off between batches (a recording gap), tick "I have verified the record interval" instead.

already_syncing.message: A history sync is already running.
